generation.prompt_exact:
EDIT the supplied inspected ChirpNeighbors clean San Diego oak/riparian shade-pocket yard foundation into ONE seasonal version. Keep EXACTLY the supplied 1536 x 1024 canvas, camera, horizon, perspective and composition. This is the SAME saved yard, not a redesign. Preserve every existing low stone-border position and silhouette, including the large left foreground border stones, the shallow central receding curve, the right endpoint boulder, all soil/stone ground contacts, and the uninterrupted open soil placement stage. Do not shift, add, remove or replace stones. Stage x=380..1270,y=700..980 stays light, calm, empty and usable. Preserve the side banks and depth. NO foreground oak, close trunk or branches, near plants, plant clumps, pots, furniture, feeders, baths, fountains, birds, animals, people, water features, text or UI. No new species. Distant existing evergreen canopy silhouettes remain distant baked scenery only; no new separate trees. Detailed naturalistic pixel art matched to input: deliberate stepped pixel clusters and restrained material shading; quiet sky/distance, low contrast fine ground texture. No graphic redesign, filter-only recolor, busy ground, heavy new shadows or orange forest. Season must be actual authored static art through modest sky/light, distant foliage and substrate surface state changes, while near geometry stays fixed. Entire image opaque, no transparency and no cutout layers. Do not imply separable objects. A later fixed crop [0,160,1536,1024] becomes 960x540 and 384x216; keep critical ground contacts/stage inside this crop.

WINTER / MOIST SEASON in San Diego: cool diffuse pale blue-gray daylight with soft higher cloud cover; subtly moister compacted soil in cool buff-gray/taupe, mildly darkened near peripheral banks and stone bases. Keep central stage light/readable, matte and open, no puddles or reflections. Existing distant evergreen canopy shows restrained green recovery after rain, distinct from summer dusty olive without becoming lush tropical jungle. Preserve all stone geometry, silhouette and contacts exactly. No snow, ice, frost blanket, icicles, universally bare forest, new close plants or foreground oak.
